What is the average track length per media type, in minutes?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC;"}
